claim_limits: Only operator rotor diameter and rated power are confirmed equipment specifications; pairing that specification with these GIS individuals remains tentative.
Hub height, seabed depth, jacket structure, yaw, blade section/twist, nacelle details, deck and access equipment are adjustable visual estimates, not engineering drawings.
Source GIS coordinates are preserved; individual turbines have not been independently surveyed or matched to every object in the photograph.
Land/shore/ocean colours are synthetic PBR visualization materials; no photographic surface texture is reproduced.
